# UnifyOne

> UnifyOne (by 1Commerce LLC, Canby, OR) is a multi-tenant commerce platform
> for gig workers, resellers, and small e-commerce operators. It unifies
> storefronts, payments (Stripe, PayPal, Square, Shopify), subscription
> billing, analytics, team collaboration, affiliate management, and an
> AI assistant (Kai) into one dashboard.

UnifyOne helps independent operators run the business side of selling across
multiple platforms from a single account: connect sales channels and payment
processors, track orders and customers, manage payouts and cash flow, and
automate routine work. The public surface below is server-rendered and free
to read; the authenticated app lives behind sign-in.
